note: North shore of Lake Shelbyville near Sullivan, in oak-hickory woods on bluffs above the lake; the banks are steep, and from many sites the water is hard to reach. Area 5 sits on a point over the main lake. Playground, dog park, fish-cleaning station and a high-water boat ramp; double sites take two RVs. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov record, rates, catalog and calendar read: USACE-run, 135 sites (131 RV, 4 tent-only), all 50 A electric, full hookups at 53, $18 ($24 Area 4B; 2026, 2027), 100% reservable, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14 in 30; showers, flush toilets, dump, laundry. Groups written manual; note cleaned. Waterfront: stored lakefront -> recommend lakeview (steep 9-10 m wooded banks). Pin ~520 m from the site centroid: move recommended.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, not --AWH; stored evidence rested on rec.gov's blanket 'Lakefront' tag): DOWNGRADE to LAKEVIEW recommended. recreation.gov itself: 'This facility lies on the shoreline with a steep descent down to the water' and 'The banks are steep and it may be difficult to get to the water from many sites'. Measured: the tagged sites sit 9-11 m above the 182.8 m summer pool. Site 133 (39.550176,-88.623286), the most open of them (photo: gravel pad with the lake below through scattered trees): 191.6 m at the pad, 188.5 m at 20 m, 184.1 m at 31 m, water at ~38-42 m: a ~9 m bank at ~28%, wooded fringe on imagery. Site 027 (39.555346,-88.620321) on the Area 2 point: 192.0 m, wooded slope to a cove ~80-95 m north (photo: lake glimpsed through dense woods). Area 5 sites 131-136 are under continuous canopy ~30-60 m above the south shore; site 135 192.9 m. Areas 1, 3 and 4A tagged sites (005-008, 043-047, 060-067) are likewise in woods on the bluff over the narrow north cove. Tent-only 138-141 do not count. Lake view by the bluff rule.

PIN: stored 39.5513889,-88.6222222 is on the Area 5 loop, ~520 m SW of the 135-site centroid; move to 39.55417,-88.61731 (centroid, Area 3, between the seven loops: Area 1 39.55403,-88.6219; Area 2 39.55476,-88.62006; Area 3 39.5543,-88.61731; 4A 39.55553,-88.6151; 4B 39.55572,-88.61327; 4C 39.55428,-88.61198; Area 5 39.55097,-88.62111).
